metadata.portfolio_scope: Claims deployment assets reviewed for cross-customer reuse

scales.standardization: 1 unique implementation to 5 stable shared contract
scales.security_variance: 1 uniform control to 5 materially different boundaries

overrides.RETIRE: Use when lifecycle_status is retire regardless of score

decision_definitions.PRODUCT: Versioned supported capability with a standard customer-facing contract and roadmap owner.
decision_definitions.PLATFORM: Shared internal service or framework used by multiple deployments with platform ownership.
decision_definitions.CONFIGURATION: Supported declarative variation that does not fork shared code.
decision_definitions.CUSTOM_EXTENSION: Isolated customer-specific component with funding owner review date and no shared-core fork.
decision_definitions.RETIRE: Remove or archive because value and reuse do not justify ongoing maintenance.

portfolio_rules: No permanent customer-specific fork of shared product or platform code.
Product and platform decisions require repeated demand and a named owner.
Configuration must use a supported contract rather than copied source.
Custom extensions require customer funding an isolation boundary and a dated review.
Retirement must identify the dependency check and removal action.
review_cadence: Quarterly portfolio review using deployment evidence support cost adoption and repeated demand
